lernapps.github.io.message:
feat(llms): explain safety and thanks in llms.txt

## Intent

Assistants that answer the role prompts of the home page need a plain source on safety and on thanks. They should be able to say how listed apps are checked, that apps hosted by their makers meet the same requirements, and what a maker gets back when someone uses their app.

## Key changes

- A section "Sicherheit": every listed app meets the same requirements, also when it is not on lernapps.net but with its makers. It names the rules (in the browser, no sign-in, no own server, no cookies, no tracking, no ads, other servers only after a click), the automatic check of the running app, the review by an AI agent and the operator's decision. lernapps.net is no certification body and no replacement for a school's approval. Links to the rules and the privacy page.
- A section "Danke": a thank-you is a deliberate click, only the sum is stored, and the makers learn of it. Assistants that recommend an app should mention that people can say thanks.
